# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 1 Slot 84: Dynamic Epidemics, Venetian Double-Island Lazarettos, Habsburg Pestkordon & Wu Youxing Wenyi Lun (oe_dis_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_dynamic_diseases.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Rule #15 Wrapper Triggers (Stage plugs oe_rule_is_dynamic_epidemic_* here)
# global_var:oe_dis_rule_override: 0/unset = follow Rule #15 (Historic pre-Stage),
#                                  1 = Historic, 2 = Mild, 3 = Off.
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. Rule #15 = Off (O(1) sleep for both new native diseases & quarterly checks).
# STAGE_PLUG_RULE_15_OFF (plugged in v110/stage: override 1/2/3 wins, otherwise Rule #15)
oe_dis_rule_is_off = {
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_dis_rule_override ?= 3
		AND = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_dis_rule_override ?= 1 }
			NOT = { global_var:oe_dis_rule_override ?= 2 }
			oe_rule_is_dynamic_epidemic_off = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Rule #15 = Mild (lower spawn cadence + automatic 50% relief buffer).
# STAGE_PLUG_RULE_15_MILD (plugged in v110/stage)
oe_dis_rule_is_mild = {
	NOT = { oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes }
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_dis_rule_override ?= 2
		AND = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_dis_rule_override ?= 1 }
			oe_rule_is_dynamic_epidemic_mild = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Rule #15 = Historic (default full intensity).
oe_dis_rule_is_historic = {
	NOT = { oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes }
	NOT = { oe_dis_rule_is_mild = yes }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Cross-System Synergy Triggers (v9.8 Asclepius + v10.0/v12.5 Ever-Normal Granaries)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. v9.8 Asclepius sanctuary synergy (exists = religion + hellenism + seated god + Epidaurus/Pergamon).
oe_dis_has_asclepius_synergy = {
	exists = religion
	religion = religion:hellenism_religion
	has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
	OR = {
		owns = location:damala
		owns = location:bergama
	}
}

# Country scope. v10.0 Ever-Normal Granary building or v12.5 W1 granary cabinet relief flag.
oe_dis_has_granary_relief = {
	OR = {
		oe_cri2_w1_granary_active = yes
		has_variable = oe_econ2_has_ever_normal_granary
		any_owned_location = {
			has_building = building_type:oe_econ2_ever_normal_granary
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Sanitary Infrastructure, Infection & Regional Eligibility Triggers
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Has built at least one vanilla lazaretto or Venetian island lazaretto.
oe_dis_has_any_lazaretto = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_dis_vecchio_built
		has_variable = oe_dis_nuovo_built
		any_owned_location = {
			OR = {
				has_building = building_type:lazaretto
				has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio
				has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Operates the full Venetian double-island filter (Vecchio + Nuovo).
oe_dis_has_double_lazaretto = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_dis_double_lazaretto_built
		AND = {
			any_owned_location = { has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio }
			any_owned_location = { has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Operates a frontier Pestkordon station or national Pestkordon cordon.
oe_dis_has_pestkordon = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_dis_pestkordon_built
		has_variable = oe_dis_pestkordon_enacted
		any_owned_location = {
			has_building = building_type:oe_dis_pestkordon_station
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Currently struck by either early modern dynamic disease or vanilla plague/typhus.
oe_dis_country_infected_any = {
	OR = {
		country_has_disease = disease:oe_dis_levantine_plague
		country_has_disease = disease:oe_dis_camp_fever
		country_has_disease = disease:bubonic_plague
		country_has_disease = disease:typhus
	}
}

# Country scope. Self or an immediate neighbor is suffering an epidemic outbreak.
oe_dis_neighbor_or_self_infected = {
	OR = {
		oe_dis_country_infected_any = yes
		any_neighbor_country = {
			OR = {
				country_has_disease = disease:oe_dis_levantine_plague
				country_has_disease = disease:oe_dis_camp_fever
				country_has_disease = disease:bubonic_plague
				country_has_disease = disease:typhus
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope. Coastal Eurasian/Mediterranean trade hub eligible for Levantine plague seeding.
oe_dis_is_levantine_plague_port = {
	is_coastal = yes
	OR = {
		region = region:italy_region
		region = region:balkan_region
		region = region:anatolia_region
		region = region:egypt_region
		region = region:crescent_region
		region = region:maghreb_region
		region = region:france_region
		region = region:east_china_region
		region = region:south_china_region
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible to promulgate Wu Youxing's Wenyi Lun (East Asia / Silk Road or literate realm).
oe_dis_is_wenyi_eligible_realm = {
	OR = {
		average_country_literacy >= 25
		has_variable = oe_dis_wenyi_unlocked
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				region = region:north_china_region
				region = region:east_china_region
				region = region:south_china_region
				region = region:manchuria_region
				region = region:korea_region
				region = region:japan_region
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Eastern Mediterranean / Islamicate realm eligible for the Karantina reform debate.
oe_dis_is_karantina_realm = {
	OR = {
		tag = TUR
		tag = MAM
		tag = EGY
		tag = IRA
		tag = TIM
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				region = region:anatolia_region
				region = region:crescent_region
				region = region:egypt_region
				region = region:persia_region
				region = region:maghreb_region
			}
		}
	}
}
